filing_fee_notes: Formation fee excludes the separate Statement of Information fee and annual LLC tax.
registered_agent_rules: Designate an agent for service of process. An individual agent uses a California physical street address; a corporate agent must be active and registered with the Secretary of State.
annual_report_due: Initially within 90 days of registration, then every two years.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Generally 800 annual LLC tax, plus an additional LLC fee when applicable. Annual tax is generally due on the 15th day of the fourth month of the taxable year; statutory exceptions apply.
state_tax_registration_agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration; Franchise Tax Board for LLC income tax and annual tax
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and keep an operating agreement. File Statements of Information and handle the separate annual LLC tax.
common_mistake: Assuming the formation fee covers the annual LLC tax.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Name reservation fee is the base fee on the official paper form; its older online-unavailable statement is superseded by the current FAQ. Detailed recurring Statement filing window, processing time, expedite options and publication were not confirmed. Tax registration URL covers CDTFA permits, not all FTB obligations.
